t8_fixes.rationale: One stray leading space on a module-level import, masked until now by the earlier !pip parse failure at line 11. Not a notebook magic and not a defect of the algorithm: a single whitespace byte that makes ast.parse fail with 'unexpected indent'. Declared explicitly, matched byte-for-byte before application, and reversible, so it satisfies clause (2) of the byte-identity rule. Ratified as decision E-13 / answer (a) to open question 1 of the S0.2 chat.

discards.rationale: Dead branch. The working-branch file of the same name was committed at S0.1 to its own ancestor path; a tree containing both resolves imports by whichever is seen last. Nothing in the tree imports this file. Removed with 'git rm' by S02_discard.sh, not by decolab.py, so that the deletion appears in git history as a deliberate act rather than as a side effect of a transform tool.
